description: Source code for Naive Bayes classifier implementation in Apache Spark's MLlib, including model class, training methods, and serialization logic.

classes.name: NaiveBayesModel
classes.description: Model class for Naive Bayes classifiers, supporting prediction, probability estimation, and serialization.

classes.name: NaiveBayes
classes.description: Trainer class for Naive Bayes models, supporting configuration and training on RDDs.

methods.name: predict
methods.description: Predicts class label for an RDD of feature vectors or a single feature vector.

methods.name: predictProbabilities
methods.description: Predicts posterior class probabilities for an RDD or a single feature vector.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Trains a Naive Bayes model given an RDD of labeled points.

methods.name: setLambda
methods.description: Sets the smoothing parameter for Naive Bayes training.

methods.name: setModelType
methods.description: Sets the type of Naive Bayes model ('multinomial' or 'bernoulli').
